trapRisks.name: Ambiguous Affordance
trapRisks.defaultFix: Clarify labels, state styling, cursor/focus behavior, and primary/secondary action hierarchy.

trapRisks.name: Missing State
trapRisks.defaultFix: Add explicit default, loading, empty, error, success, disabled, focus, and selected states.

trapRisks.name: Silent System
trapRisks.defaultFix: Add progress feedback, status copy, completion receipts, and failure reasons near the action.
trapRisks.note: No static-scan evidence path exists for this trap — 'not-assessed' means unverified, not clear.

trapRisks.name: Choice Overload
trapRisks.defaultFix: Group related choices, reduce simultaneous options, and reveal advanced controls after intent.

trapRisks.name: Layout Instability
trapRisks.defaultFix: Add responsive constraints, stable dimensions, overflow rules, and route-level breakpoint coverage.

trapRisks.name: Token Drift
trapRisks.defaultFix: Promote repeated colors, spacing, type, radius, and elevation into semantic tokens and variants.

trapRisks.name: Inaccessible Interaction
trapRisks.defaultFix: Patch semantic markup, focus states, labels, alternatives, contrast, and reduced-motion behavior.

trapRisks.name: Copy Theater
trapRisks.defaultFix: Replace decorative or generic copy with task-specific labels, outcomes, and constraints.

trapRisks.name: Context Leak
trapRisks.defaultFix: Persist current context in receipts, breadcrumbs, session records, and recovery flows.
trapRisks.note: No static-scan evidence path exists for this trap — 'not-assessed' means unverified, not clear.

trapRisks.name: Destructive Default
trapRisks.defaultFix: Make destructive paths explicit, reversible where possible, and guarded with clear confirmation.

findings.title: Raw colors are leaking into UI code
evidence: Hardcoded hex values make redesigns brittle and block consistent theme generation.
findings.recommendation: Move recurring colors into CSS variables or Tailwind theme tokens.

findings.title: Color utility surface is too wide
evidence: A broad color utility set usually means states and surfaces are being styled case by case.
findings.recommendation: Collapse colors into semantic roles: background, surface, foreground, muted, primary, destructive, success, warning.

findings.title: Typography scale is drifting
evidence: Many text sizes make hierarchy harder to read and harder to maintain.
findings.recommendation: Use a tighter type ramp and reserve large sizes for page-level hierarchy.

findings.title: Spacing scale is too loose
evidence: Large spacing variety creates an uneven rhythm across routes and components.
findings.recommendation: Normalize spacing around a smaller set of layout and component gaps.

findings.title: Shadow styles are inconsistent
evidence: Many shadow treatments create noisy depth and weak hierarchy.
findings.recommendation: Define one elevation scale and reserve shadows for layered surfaces.

findings.title: Too many arbitrary Tailwind values
evidence: Arbitrary values are useful during exploration but become design debt when repeated.
findings.recommendation: Promote repeated arbitrary values into tokens or named utilities.
